fusions.name: Slammed Tome
fusions.desc: Brings a bound volume down two-handed for 16 damage, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Flung Folio
fusions.desc: Hurls a heavy folio overarm for 28 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its maximum range of 7 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Chest-Thumped Decree
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cracked Spine
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
